segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: A blank check company seeking to combine with one or more target businesses; it has not commenced operations or generated revenue.
segments.evidence: Future Vision II Acquisition Corp. is a blank check company incorporated as a Cayman Islands exempted company on January 30, 2024 for the purpose of effecting a merger, share exchange, asset acquisition, share purchase, reorganization or similar business combination with one or more businesses (a "Business Combination").

revenueModel.text: The company has no operating customers; it earns non-operating interest income on trust account proceeds from its IPO and private placement.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company will generate non-operating income in the form of interest income from the proceeds derived from the Initial Public Offering and Private Placement (as defined below).
